verdict.rationale: 2FAS describes 2FAS Auth as a 'Free, Open-source 2FA Authenticator App'. Its browser extension code is published on GitHub, and 2FAS explicitly invites community code review. 2FAS Pass is described as source-available, a weaker claim than open source, though still framed as verifiable by independent experts. Missing for 10: an explicit link to the mobile app repositories that handle seeds, license details, and independent corroboration of actual community or third-party audits.

support.subject: As a security engineer, the client apps are open source, so the code handling my seeds can be inspected and community-reviewed

citations.quote: You can easily take a look at our code - reflecting our transparent and user-first approach. Check out our GitHub repository
Join our GitHub project and contribute to 2FAS by running code review and committing your ideas.
Source-available code ensures that every security feature we use can be verified by independent security experts.
